exportDocs.column.name: Name
exportDocs.file.mark: This file was made by SpecBoard from the project "{project}". Make changes in the project
exportDocs.pointsAt.byFieldMatched: artifact named by {here} (matched against {there} of the target)
exportDocs.rule.absentIf: When the condition in when holds, the field in then must be absent
exportDocs.rule.chainedBy: Pins the previous generation by its digest, not by its generation number
exportDocs.rule.derivedFrom: Must match the value recomputed from the path in from
exportDocs.rule.gteRef: Must be greater than or equal to the referenced value
exportDocs.rule.lteRef: Must be less than or equal to the referenced value
exportDocs.rule.memberOf: The value must be in the set at target. Where pointsAt's in says “where it is defined”, this narrows “how much of that may be used”
exportDocs.rule.monotonicPerKey: Must increase monotonically for each combination of keys
exportDocs.rule.requiredIf: When the condition in when holds, the field in then must be present
exportDocs.rule.sortedBy: The array must be in this order. If field is omitted, the elements themselves are compared
exportDocs.rule.uniqueBy: No duplicates in the array. If field is omitted, the elements themselves are compared
